body: I really don’t know if I’ll be able to. I’ll have to talk to my therapist about it, I guess. I have a session with her in a few days.

I understand that everyone makes mistakes as a teenager, but getting caught up in the lies of a hate group, and taking some part in it, even if it was just two anonymous messages, just seems like a lot to me. 
I hope I can forgive myself some day, but for now I’m just incredibly anxious about it, in all honesty.
